howItWorks.title: How to convert PNG to PDF
steps: Upload one or more PNG images.
Drag them, or use the arrow buttons, to set the order you want.
Click Start and download your PDF.

items.q: Is converting PNG to PDF free?
items.a: Yes, converting images to PDF is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Can I convert multiple images at once?
items.a: Yes, each image becomes one page in the resulting PDF, in the order you choose.

items.q: Will my files be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
